fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker visible from the road at the driveway entrance.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the front of the residence.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can move around it on foot.
• Mark any pedestrian access path to the rear of the property so responders can locate it quickly on arrival.
• Keep a gate or opening in any rear fence or vegetation line unlocked and accessible from the outside.
• Identify and mark a secondary on-property staging area, such as the open lawn, where emergency vehicles can turn around or park without blocking the single driveway access point.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from trees growing close to or over any structure on the property.
• Thin the tree cluster to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of any structure.
• Clear low-hanging branches from scattered trees near structures so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Cut back shrubs and low vegetation growing along the sides of the driveway to keep it passable.
• Trim overhanging branches above the driveway that could fall and block access.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from within the mixed vegetation areas closest to any structure.
• Clear vegetation and debris from the rear of the property to open a path for movement around the structure.
• Keep the area immediately behind the structure free of shrubs and dense plant growth to allow access from the rear.
• Separate shrub clusters from nearby trees so plants are not touching or intertwined.
